question: Does the single complete-family pooled rank48 interface remain bidirectionally sufficient and selective when the exchanged cue embedding is perturbed by independent 10% norm-matched Gaussian noise?

prior_art.crossfit_source_noise: The split-specific forward interface passed three 10% source-noise seeds, but its minimum behavior recovery was 0.7981 and it did not test reverse execution.
prior_art.pooled_clean_forward: The pooled interface passed clean forward OOD with behavior recovery 0.8144/0.8275 and no control flips.
prior_art.pooled_clean_reverse: The identical pooled projector passed clean reverse OOD with behavior recovery 0.8126/0.8240 and no control flips.

evaluation: Fit the deterministic projector only on temporal-v13/iswas-v12 plus matched controls, evaluate row-disjoint temporal-v12/iswas-v11 targets and P controls, and perturb only the exchanged source-token embedding by 10% of the clean cue displacement norm for seeds 1729, 2718, and 3141 in both directions.

predictions.pred_a_authority_hash_noise_tripwire_fin: Authorities and pooled projector hashes reproduce, fit/evaluation IDs are disjoint, every source exchange changes exactly one token, noise ratios lie in [0.099,0.101], all values are finite, and exactly 39 forwards execute.
predictions.pred_b_all_noisy_bidirectional_coordinat: Across every seed and direction, minimum coordinate projection is at least 0.75 and mean/worst coordinate residual are at most 0.20.
predictions.pred_c_all_noisy_bidirectional_behaviors: Across every seed and direction, both behavior projections are at least 0.80 and worst target residual is at most 0.15.
predictions.pred_d_all_noisy_bidirectional_controls_: Across every seed and direction, control margin RMS is at most 0.10, median full-vocabulary KL is at most 0.02, and no control top-one prediction flips.
predictions.pred_e_seed_and_direction_stability: Within each direction, seed ranges for minimum coordinate and each behavior projection are at most 0.08, and paired forward/reverse behavior projections differ by at most 0.08.

decision: All five predictions license the hash-identified pooled rank48 interface as bidirectional and 10%-source-noise robust on disjoint OOD. Failure localizes whether the clean result depends on direction, seed, coordinates, target behavior, or controls.
